create.name: Devon Hase
create.bio:
Devon Hase is an Insight Meditation teacher who came to practice as a college student in 2000 and has since passed over six years in total on silent retreat in the Insight and Vajrayana traditions. Joseph Goldstein, Tara Brach and Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche are among her main teachers, and with her husband, nico Hase, she completed a traditional three-year Tibetan retreat. Before teaching the dharma full time she spent ten years in high school and college classrooms. She trained through Spirit Rock's Community Dharma Leaders programme and the IMS teacher training, and now helps coordinate the Community Dharma Leaders programme at Spirit Rock.

Devon teaches on retreat teams at IMS, the Forest Refuge, Spirit Rock and other centres, offering lovingkindness, metta jhāna and body-based insight practice. With nico she guides Refuge of Belonging, an online sangha of more than two hundred members that meets for monthly half-day retreats on the Eightfold Path, multi-week classes, free talks and a yearly residential retreat at Crestone Mountain Zen Center in Colorado. They also offer one-to-one dharma mentoring. Their teaching leans towards ordinary life: emotions, conflict and long-term relationships. Together they wrote How Not to Be a Hot Mess (2020) and This Messy, Gorgeous Love (2026), a Buddhist guide to partnership.

books.title: How Not to Be a Hot Mess: A Buddhist Survival Guide for Modern Life
books.author: Devon Hase and Craig Hase
books.description: A short, plain-spoken guide from Shambhala built around six simple rules for staying upright in daily life, from meditating and acting kindly to speaking honestly and keeping a clear mind. Written with her husband, then publishing as Craig Hase.

books.title: This Messy, Gorgeous Love: A Buddhist Guide to Lasting Partnership
books.author: Devon Hase and Nico Hase
books.description: A guide to treating a committed relationship as part of the spiritual path. It draws on meditation and Buddhist ethics for staying present with strong feelings, talking through conflict and finding each other again after difficult stretches.

courses.title: Metta Weekend Retreat with Sharon Salzberg (IMS Online, 2027)
courses.description: An online lovingkindness weekend for IMS co-taught with Sharon Salzberg, with guided and silent sitting, walking practice, talks and time for questions. Open to all levels; participants are encouraged to keep a quiet home retreat for the weekend.
courses.price: $150, $300 or $400 USD (choose your rate, IMS Online)

courses.title: Metta Jhanas at the Forest Refuge (March 2027)
courses.description: Three weeks at the Forest Refuge in Barre, taught with Devin Berry, using lovingkindness as the object for deep concentration. Retreatants can come for a week or stay longer.
courses.price: From $115 USD per night (IMS 2027 sliding scale, minimum 7 nights)

courses.title: See It Straight: A Half-Day Retreat on Right View
courses.description: An online half-day with devon and nico on Right View, opening their year-long series on the Eightfold Path: how actions ripen, and how seeing the causes of suffering shapes the way we live.

courses.title: The Body Contemplations: A Four-Week Class
courses.description: Four Tuesday evening sessions on Zoom studying and practising the full first foundation of mindfulness from the Satipaṭṭhāna Sutta, including the parts of the body, the four elements and the charnel-ground reflections.

courses.title: Ten Things Not to Say Today: A Half-Day Retreat on Right Speech
courses.description: An online half-day led by devon on the four classical forms of wise speech: truthfulness, harmony, kindness and restraint.

courses.title: Fifth Annual Refuge of Belonging Retreat at Crestone Mountain Zen Center
courses.description: A week of residential practice with devon and nico at Crestone Mountain Zen Center in Colorado, the yearly gathering of their Refuge of Belonging community. Offered on a dana basis with a deposit to hold a place.
courses.price: Dana (no fixed tuition); $300 USD non-refundable deposit

courses.title: Dharma Mentoring with devon + nico
courses.description: Monthly one-to-one meetings of half an hour for committed students, tailored to their practice and life situation. Students usually attend some teachings first.

free_resources.title: Devon Hase's Dharma Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: More than 250 recorded talks and guided meditations from retreats, free to stream or download.

free_resources.title: Free Talks with nico + devon hase
free_resources.description: Occasional free dharma talks on Zoom with time for community connection. No registration; dates are sent to the mailing list.
